why: deletes overriding method(s) castVote, getTargetType, labels, targets: whatever they did is gone -- port each to the new API, or say why vanilla no longer needs it
reviewed: On FML 10's ClassProcessor these four have direct equivalents: targets() is handlesClass over the same targetNames(), castVote YES and getTargetType CLASS are implied by handlesClass on a class Type, and labels() is name() (eca:eca_core); transform is processClass over the same transformNode.

why: removes 2 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: Each removed handler is re-done on 1.21.10's frame graph with 1.21.1's effect, not only moved. renderClouds HEAD: lambda$addCloudsPass$3 calls DimensionSpecialEffects.renderClouds(LevelRenderState,...) before CloudRenderer.render, so the overlay cancels that lambda at the renderClouds call (require = 1) and a dimension drawing its own clouds is skipped too; CloudRendererMixin still gates CloudRenderer.render. renderSky TAIL: AfterSky is posted only inside the sky pass, which renderLevel omits when its render-sky flag is false (GameRenderer passes !(isFoggyAt || boss world fog)) and addSkyPass omits for SkyType NONE, lava/powder snow or blindness/darkness, and it is posted even after a custom renderSky returned true; so the overlay adds an eca_global_skybox pass on targets.main just before addMainPass, sets renderLevel's world fog buffer with RenderSystem.setShaderFog as the sky pass does, skips it when lambda$addSkyPass$8's renderSky returned true, and sets GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned so the AfterSky handler stands down. The PoseStack starts from identity because renderLevel has multiplied the view matrix onto the model-view stack and LegacyGl/RenderType.draw upload getModelViewMatrix() as ModelViewMat. The renderEntity HEAD/RETURN bracket is the extractVisibleEntities frustum capture plus the @Redirect of EntityRenderDispatcher.submit in submitEntities (entities are submitted, not drawn, there).

The provider's only effect is its static initialiser (kept), which FML 10's ServiceLoaderUtil.loadEarlyServices still runs by instantiating every provider; the three empty bodies are FML 10's initialize(ProgramArgs) and the new setMinecraftVersion/setNeoForgeVersion, where the authors' initialize already did nothing.
